NHANES Cumulative Logit Ordinal Regression

Manasvi Saite and Kaushal Mayur

1 Colour Names Used in Graphs

bar_colour <- "pink"
histogram_colour <- "lightblue"
box_fill_colour <- "pink"
box_border_colour <- "black"

2 Data Preparation

data(NHANES)

df <- NHANES %>%
  mutate(
    Health = ordered(
      HealthGen,
      levels = c("Excellent", "Vgood", "Good", "Fair", "Poor"),
      labels = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")
    ),
    Age = as.numeric(Age),
    Gender = factor(Gender),
    BMI = as.numeric(BMI),
    Smoking = factor(SmokeNow, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Health, Age, Gender, BMI, Smoking) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  droplevels()

summary(df)
##        Health          Age           Gender          BMI        Smoking   
##  Excellent: 213   Min.   :20.00   female:1236   Min.   :15.02   No :1581

##  Good     :1228   Median :49.00                 Median :27.70             
##  Fair     : 496   Mean   :49.25                 Mean   :28.56             
##  Poor     :  99   3rd Qu.:62.00                 3rd Qu.:32.00             
##                   Max.   :80.00                 Max.   :67.83

6 Parallel Cumulative Logit Model

parallel_model <- vglm(
  Health ~ Age + BMI + Gender + Smoking,
  family = cumulative(link = "logitlink", parallel = TRUE),
  data = df,
  model = TRUE
)

summary(parallel_model)
## 
## Call:
## vglm(formula = Health ~ Age + BMI + Gender + Smoking, family = cumulative(link = "logitlink", 
##     parallel = TRUE), data = df, model = TRUE)
## 
## Coefficients: 
##                Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept):1  0.473418   0.211848   2.235   0.0254 *  
## (Intercept):2  2.561695   0.210660  12.160  < 2e-16 ***
## (Intercept):3  4.590259   0.223261  20.560  < 2e-16 ***
## (Intercept):4  6.648358   0.247107  26.905  < 2e-16 ***
## Age           -0.011812   0.002196  -5.379  7.5e-08 ***
## BMI           -0.073276   0.005620 -13.038  < 2e-16 ***
## Gendermale    -0.153296   0.069597  -2.203   0.0276 *  
## SmokingYes    -0.839791   0.075197 -11.168  < 2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Names of linear predictors: logitlink(P[Y<=1]), logitlink(P[Y<=2]), 
## logitlink(P[Y<=3]), logitlink(P[Y<=4])
## 
## Residual deviance: 7418.731 on 11532 degrees of freedom
## 
## Log-likelihood: -3709.366 on 11532 degrees of freedom
## 
## Number of Fisher scoring iterations: 4 
## 
## 
## Exponentiated coefficients:
##        Age        BMI Gendermale SmokingYes 
##  0.9882572  0.9293442  0.8578759  0.4318007

6.1 Parallel Model Coefficients and Odds Ratios

parallel_coef <- coef(parallel_model)

parallel_predictor_coef <- parallel_coef[
  names(parallel_coef) %in% c("Age", "BMI", "Gendermale", "SmokingYes")
]

parallel_or <- exp(parallel_predictor_coef)

parallel_results <- data.frame(
  Predictor = c("Age", "BMI", "Male", "Smoking Yes"),
  Estimate = round(as.numeric(parallel_predictor_coef), 4),
  Odds_Ratio = round(as.numeric(parallel_or), 3)
)

kable(parallel_results)
Predictor Estimate Odds_Ratio
Age -0.0118 0.988
BMI -0.0733 0.929
Male -0.1533 0.858
Smoking Yes -0.8398 0.432

6.2 Parallel Model Fit Summary

parallel_residual_deviance <- deviance(parallel_model)
parallel_loglik <- as.numeric(logLik(parallel_model))
parallel_aic <- AIC(parallel_model)
parallel_bic <- BIC(parallel_model)

parallel_fit <- data.frame(
  Measure = c("Residual deviance", "Log-likelihood", "AIC", "BIC"),
  Value = round(c(
    parallel_residual_deviance,
    parallel_loglik,
    parallel_aic,
    parallel_bic
  ), 3)
)

kable(parallel_fit)
Measure Value
Residual deviance 7418.732
Log-likelihood -3709.366
AIC 7434.732
BIC 7482.470

7 Non-Parallel Cumulative Logit Model

nonparallel_model <- vglm(
  Health ~ Age + BMI + Gender + Smoking,
  family = cumulative(link = "logitlink", parallel = FALSE),
  data = df,
  model = TRUE
)

7.1 Non-Parallel Model Coefficients

nonparallel_coef <- coef(nonparallel_model)

nonparallel_table <- data.frame(
  Coefficient = c("Intercept", "Age", "BMI", "Gender male", "Smoking Yes"),
  Threshold_1 = round(c(
    nonparallel_coef["(Intercept):1"],
    nonparallel_coef["Age:1"],
    nonparallel_coef["BMI:1"],
    nonparallel_coef["Gendermale:1"],
    nonparallel_coef["SmokingYes:1"]
  ), 4),
  Threshold_2 = round(c(
    nonparallel_coef["(Intercept):2"],
    nonparallel_coef["Age:2"],
    nonparallel_coef["BMI:2"],
    nonparallel_coef["Gendermale:2"],
    nonparallel_coef["SmokingYes:2"]
  ), 4),
  Threshold_3 = round(c(
    nonparallel_coef["(Intercept):3"],
    nonparallel_coef["Age:3"],
    nonparallel_coef["BMI:3"],
    nonparallel_coef["Gendermale:3"],
    nonparallel_coef["SmokingYes:3"]
  ), 4),
  Threshold_4 = round(c(
    nonparallel_coef["(Intercept):4"],
    nonparallel_coef["Age:4"],
    nonparallel_coef["BMI:4"],
    nonparallel_coef["Gendermale:4"],
    nonparallel_coef["SmokingYes:4"]
  ), 4)
)

kable(nonparallel_table)

7.2 Residual Deviance Comparison

nonparallel_residual_deviance <- deviance(nonparallel_model)

deviance_comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Parallel model", "Non-parallel model", "Difference"),
  Residual_Deviance = c(
    round(parallel_residual_deviance, 3),
    round(nonparallel_residual_deviance, 3),
    round(parallel_residual_deviance - nonparallel_residual_deviance, 3)
  )
)

kable(deviance_comparison)
Model Residual_Deviance
Parallel model 7418.732
Non-parallel model 7417.663
Difference 1.069

8 Predicted Probabilities

8.1 Prediction Data

newdata_parallel <- data.frame(
  Age = seq(min(df$Age), max(df$Age), length.out = 100),
  BMI = rep(mean(df$BMI, na.rm = TRUE), 100),
  Gender = factor(rep(levels(df$Gender)[1], 100), levels = levels(df$Gender)),
  Smoking = factor(rep(levels(df$Smoking)[1], 100), levels = levels(df$Smoking))
)

newdata_nonparallel <- newdata_parallel

8.2 Predicted Probabilities: Parallel Model

pred_parallel <- predict(
  parallel_model,
  newdata = newdata_parallel,
  type = "response"
)

plot_parallel <- cbind(newdata_parallel, as.data.frame(pred_parallel)) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("Age", "BMI", "Gender", "Smoking", "Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor"),
    names_to = "Health",
    values_to = "Probability"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Health = factor(
      Health,
      levels = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")
    ),
    Model = "Parallel"
  )

p8 <- ggplot(plot_parallel, aes(x = Age, y = Probability, colour = Health)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Probabilities: Parallel Model",
    subtitle = "BMI fixed at mean, Gender fixed at reference level, Smoking = No",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted Probability",
    colour = "Health Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p8

8.3 Predicted Probabilities: Non-Parallel Model

pred_nonparallel <- predict(
  nonparallel_model,
  newdata = newdata_nonparallel,
  type = "response"
)

plot_nonparallel <- cbind(newdata_nonparallel, as.data.frame(pred_nonparallel)) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("Age", "BMI", "Gender", "Smoking", "Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor"),
    names_to = "Health",
    values_to = "Probability"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Health = factor(
      Health,
      levels = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")
    ),
    Model = "Non-parallel"
  )

p9 <- ggplot(plot_nonparallel, aes(x = Age, y = Probability, colour = Health)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Probabilities: Non-Parallel Model",
    subtitle = "BMI fixed at mean, Gender fixed at reference level, Smoking = No",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted Probability",
    colour = "Health Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p9

8.4 Parallel vs Non-Parallel Predicted Probabilities

plot_both <- bind_rows(plot_parallel, plot_nonparallel)

p10 <- ggplot(plot_both, aes(x = Age, y = Probability, colour = Health)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Model) +
  labs(
    title = "Parallel vs Non-Parallel Predicted Probabilities",
    subtitle = "Predicted probabilities as age increases",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted Probability",
    colour = "Health Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p10

10 Final Model Decision

cat("\nFINAL MODEL DECISION\n")
## 
## FINAL MODEL DECISION
cat("--------------------\n")
## --------------------
cat("Parallel model residual deviance:", round(parallel_residual_deviance, 3), "\n")
## Parallel model residual deviance: 7418.732
cat("Non-parallel model residual deviance:", round(nonparallel_residual_deviance, 3), "\n")
## Non-parallel model residual deviance: 7417.663
cat("Difference:", round(parallel_residual_deviance - nonparallel_residual_deviance, 3), "\n\n")
## Difference: 1.069
cat("The non-parallel model has a slightly lower residual deviance.\n")
## The non-parallel model has a slightly lower residual deviance.
cat("However, the difference is very small compared with a deviance above 7400.\n")
## However, the difference is very small compared with a deviance above 7400.
cat("Therefore, the parallel cumulative logit ordinal regression model is preferred.\n")
## Therefore, the parallel cumulative logit ordinal regression model is preferred.
